evidence.title: Jesus Camp
evidence.text: Jesus Camp is a 2006 American documentary film directed by Rachel Grady and Heidi Ewing about a Charismatic Christian summer camp, where children spend their summers being taught that they have "prophetic gifts" and can "take back America for Christ".

evidence.title: Heidi Ewing
